get_dto_fix_review.behavior: POST retains top-level execution_kind and nested safety requirements. Reader-shaped GET may omit optional top-level execution_kind and nested safety aliases, but it must preserve all direct boolean safety fields; present aliases must match exactly. Nested plan_product execution kind, status, consumed flag, owner, run/product/input identity, diagnostic MATCH, VERIFIED run readback, and equal terminal attempt identity/state/timestamps remain checked.
get_dto_fix_review.negative_controls: Focused tests cover every absent/false direct safety flag, contradictory optional aliases, wrong product status/run/product/input identity, stale diagnostics, owner mismatch, unverified run-readback, failed terminal attempt, and missing nested product execution kind.

evidence.detail: The helper writes plan-canary.json before its post-write protected-date check (908-909), fresh-state recheck (910-916), mutex recheck (917-919), and completion-receipt size/write check (1010-1014). Exceptions at any of those gates leave the already-written canary and partial output directory in place.

The plan-canary validator accepts the canary from its path and validates its internal evidence; it does not require the companion completion-receipt.json. The separately pinned conditional stage argv consumes plan-canary.json directly.

P1.impact: A nonzero offline-completion run can leave a valid PASS_OWNER_READBACK_EVIDENCE_FOR_PLAN_BINDING canary that the later stage-preparation command accepts, even though final post-write state/mutex/receipt checks did not complete. No automatic stage run is shown; the risk is that the partial artifact remains stage-acceptable.
P1.minimal_fix: Do not publish plan-canary.json until all verification, post-write state/mutex/date gates, and receipt construction/size checks pass. Prefer writing into a new private temporary output directory and publishing the complete set at the fixed path only after success; add a regression forcing a post-write gate failure and asserting no stage-acceptable canary exists. Make retry behavior explicit for an interrupted partial output.

evidence.detail: The verifier imports issue35_phase4_common.py at module load and pins its own normalized source plus the fixed validator, but _verify_source_pins does not pin or hash-check the imported support module.
The unpinned module supplies next-session selection, release loading, protected-date hashing, task/state roots, and related acceptance constants used by the parent command.
The prior frozen diagnosis records common.py SHA-256 d5e8c8aaf591d10df2343dfe1d870019ee431ad708d6478b0863c9cd53a0fa84; the current file has that same hash, but this CLI does not enforce the pin.

P2.impact: A support-module change after review could alter the command's date/state checks without changing the pinned completion-helper or GET-fix hashes.
P2.minimal_fix: Pin issue35_phase4_common.py to the already recorded SHA-256 in _verify_source_pins and add a drift-rejection test, or include an explicit parent preflight that verifies the same hash immediately before running the exact argv.
